title: Q-CLAIM-COVER-site-passkeys-js: unbound claim-like statements on site/passkeys.js
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** claims coverage, every PR and daily
**Done check:** grep:doctrine/claims.json::"surface": "site/passkeys.js"
**Status:** open

COVERAGE-1: 1 claim-like lines (first 169) on `site/passkeys.js` state a number, cadence or guarantee with no registered claim and probe.

size: S
